Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class Parameters

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.Parameters
  • Direct Known Subclasses:
    ClientParameters, ServerParameters
    public abstract class Parameters
extends Object
    Base class for parameters used to configure KDC communication entities. Parameters define common communication settings such as network binding, buffer sizes, serialization, compression, encryption, API registration, latency reporting, and other shared configuration.

    Parameter instances are created using the builder provided by the protocol-specific parameter class. Global default values may be configured through Parameters.Defaults before parameter instances are created.

    Author:
    Charles B. Kozoyed
    See Also:
    ClientParameters, ServerParameters
